description: pkix-revocation/tests/ocsp_checker_tests.rs:303-312 — ocsp-rid-bad-bykey.der corrupts the byKey hash (first byte XOR 0xFF), which is inside tbs_response_data (the signed region). This means parse_and_verify_basic_response fails with OcspSignatureInvalid at line 363 before verify_responder_id_impl is reached. The ByKey arm of verify_responder_id_impl (ocsp.rs:475-480) that returns OcspResponderIdMismatch is never reached by any existing test. To exercise this path, a fixture is needed where the signature is VALID but the byKey SHA-1 hash is computed from a different (wrong) key — e.g., sign the response with CA key A but use SHA-1(CA-B SPKI bits) as the ResponderId. The existing byName mismatch test (line 283) does reach the mismatch path because byName is in the signed data too, but the wrong-name response is signed with the correct key so signature still passes. The byKey case has no equivalent.
title: No test exercises byKey OcspResponderIdMismatch path
